# ApkStart v0.4.4.002

## Localization audit completion
- Expanded English and Persian coverage across the full application source: UI, ADB, APK parsing, emulator startup, downloads, runtime provisioning, cleanup, update flow, window agent, ZIP parsing, and diagnostics.
- Added translations for dynamic progress messages and error fragments so variable values remain intact while the surrounding message is localized.
- Preserved technical identifiers, command names, product names, and proper names where appropriate.
- Kept English as the default language and Persian right-to-left layout.

## Build and verification
- Application and lockfile version: `0.4.4.002`.
- This is the second build number in the `0.4.4` series; subsequent builds will increment the final three-digit number.
